description: One entry of a user menu (the account dropdown of TmTopBar). An entry is a command (Href for navigation, OnClick otherwise), a destructive command (IsDanger) or a separator between groups (Separator).

properties.name: Id
properties.description: Stable identifier of the entry, unique inside one menu (used for test ids and @key).

properties.name: Label
properties.description: Visible label; also the accessible name of the entry.

properties.name: Href
properties.description: Navigation URL. When set the entry renders as a link; otherwise it is a button that raises OnClick.

properties.name: OnClick
properties.description: Callback of a command entry (ignored when Href is set). The menu closes BEFORE the callback runs and awaits it. A callback that changes the HOST's own state is responsible for the render (StateHasChanged()) — it is a delegate invoked by a child component, not an EventCallback owned by the host, so no automatic re-render follows. A callback that only calls a service (navigation, a toast, a save) needs nothing.

properties.name: IsDanger
properties.description: Renders the entry in the destructive style (a red label) — a signal that must not be the ONLY cue for screen readers; the label has to be self-explanatory.

properties.name: Separator
properties.description: Renders the entry as a separator line instead of a command; Label is ignored.

examples.title: Account menu with a destructive entry
